##########################################################################
# Eire Reborn - Update 3 triggers (generated by tools/gen_script_conq.py)
##########################################################################

# Character scope: the realm holds the kingdom title $T$ itself (or through a vassal) and at least 3 of its counties.
eir_conq_realm_holds_trigger = {
	exists = title:$T$.holder
	title:$T$ = {
		holder = { top_liege = root }
	}
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		count >= 3
		kingdom = title:$T$
	}
}

# Character scope: the realm holds Scotland or Ireland (what a conqueror wants).
eir_conq_target_trigger = {
	OR = {
		eir_conq_realm_holds_trigger = { T = k_scotland }
		eir_conq_realm_holds_trigger = { T = k_ireland }
	}
}

# Character scope: nothing prevents a conqueror from coming now.
eir_conq_ready_trigger = {
	eir_is_gael_ruler_trigger = yes
	is_ai = no
	is_independent_ruler = yes
	is_at_war = no
	NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_active }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_cooldown }
	eir_conq_target_trigger = yes
}

# Character scope: some county of the realm is ravaged.
eir_has_ravaged_county_trigger = {
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		has_county_modifier = eir_ravaged_modifier
	}
}
